[South-eastern Baltic] LITHUANIAN NAV WARN 070/26
SOUTH-EASTERN BALTIC
LITHUANIAN COAST – MILITARY EXERCISES
MILITARY EXERCISES 0500–1400 UTC DAILY
21 AND 22 OCT IN AREA EYD-18, CENTERED
IN 55-29.6N 020-51.0E.

WIDE BERTH REQUESTED.
CANCEL THIS MSG 221500 UTC OCT
